decision.explanation: Both Jan P. Syse and Jean-Marie Bosch are explicitly identified in the original sources as having served as the head of government of Serralongue. Document d1 (D1S4) states that Jan P. Syse held the position, while document d2 (D2S4 and D2S11) identifies Jean-Marie Bosch as the head of government. These are two distinct individuals mentioned in separate documents, each with direct claims about the same role. Since there is no explicit contradiction between the two claims and both are supported by the original text, both are valid answers under the given instruction to preserve distinct valid referents.
